boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations in the Lancaster Avenue corridor at Suburban Square in nearby Ardmore, each with one source-backed reason to stop.

cards.title: Ardmore Farmers Market
cards.subtitle: Lancaster Avenue corridor, Suburban Square
cards.notes: Walk the market’s vendor aisles and choose from produce, prepared meals, meats, seafood, and sweets; check the posted market hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A seven-day indoor market with a broad mix of food vendors.
cards.evidence_claim: The official market page says it is open seven days a week and lists vendors offering prepared meals, produce, meats, seafood, sweet treats, and more.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Monday–Saturday 8 a.m.–6 p.m.; Sunday 9 a.m.–4 p.m.

cards.title: Ardmore Produce
cards.subtitle: Lancaster Avenue corridor, inside Ardmore Farmers Market
cards.notes: Browse the produce displays, then use the made-to-order juice bar if you want a drink prepared on site; purchases are separate from market entry.
cards.short_summary: A market produce stand that also lists a made-to-order juice bar.
cards.evidence_claim: Suburban Square identifies Ardmore Produce as a local business in the market and says it has produce plus a made-to-order fruit-and-vegetable juice bar.
cards.access_notes: Located within Ardmore Farmers Market at Suburban Square; consult the market page for current building hours.

cards.title: The Buttery
cards.subtitle: Lancaster Avenue corridor, inside Ardmore Farmers Market
cards.notes: Use this market counter for coffee, pastries, breads, soups, salads, or sandwiches when you want a compact food stop along the corridor.
cards.short_summary: A market counter listing coffee, baked goods, and savory lunch items.
cards.evidence_claim: The Suburban Square dining directory lists The Buttery in Ardmore Farmers Market and describes its coffee, pastries, breads, soups, salads, and sandwiches.
cards.access_notes: Located within Ardmore Farmers Market at Suburban Square; consult the market page for current building hours.

cards.title: Tabouli
cards.subtitle: Lancaster Avenue corridor, inside Ardmore Farmers Market
cards.notes: Pick this counter when you want Mediterranean food prepared fresh daily with whole-food ingredients; its official listing places it inside the market.
cards.short_summary: A Mediterranean-food counter in the Ardmore Farmers Market.
cards.evidence_claim: The Suburban Square dining directory describes Tabouli as Mediterranean cuisine prepared fresh daily with whole-food ingredients and locates it in Ardmore Farmers Market.
cards.access_notes: Located within Ardmore Farmers Market at Suburban Square; consult the market page for current building hours.

cards.title: CAVA
cards.subtitle: Lancaster Avenue corridor, Suburban Square
cards.notes: Build a greens-and-grains bowl, salad, or pita at this fast-casual stop; the official center directory lists all three menu formats.
cards.short_summary: A fast-casual Mediterranean option for customizable bowls, salads, and pitas.
cards.evidence_claim: Suburban Square’s dining directory describes CAVA as a fast-casual Mediterranean restaurant serving customizable greens-and-grains bowls, salads, and pitas.
cards.access_notes: At Suburban Square, whose posted general hours are Monday–Saturday 10 a.m.–8 p.m. and Sunday noon–5 p.m.; merchant hours may differ.

cards.title: Urban Outfitters
cards.subtitle: Lancaster Avenue corridor, 40 Coulter Avenue
cards.notes: Browse apparel, accessories, and home items at the Coulter Avenue storefront; its center listing supplies the exact Suburban Square address.
cards.short_summary: A retail storefront with apparel, accessories, and home merchandise.
cards.evidence_claim: The Suburban Square store page places Urban Outfitters at 40 Coulter Avenue and describes its mix of women’s, men’s, accessories, and home assortments.
cards.access_notes: At 40 Coulter Avenue, Ardmore; verify store hours directly before a visit.

cards.title: Warby Parker
cards.subtitle: Lancaster Avenue corridor, Suburban Square
cards.notes: Stop in to browse the current eyewear line or arrange an eye exam; the center directory specifically identifies both services at this location.
cards.short_summary: An eyewear shop whose directory entry also mentions eye exams.
cards.evidence_claim: Suburban Square’s shopping directory says visitors can explore Warby Parker’s eyewear line and get an eye exam at the location.
cards.access_notes: At Suburban Square; verify appointment availability and store hours directly before a visit.

cards.title: Paper Source
cards.subtitle: Lancaster Avenue corridor, Suburban Square
cards.notes: Use this named shop for stationery, paper goods, and a visually focused retail stop while moving between Lancaster Avenue and Coulter Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A named paper-goods shop listed in the Suburban Square directory.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Suburban Square shopping directory lists Paper Source as a current shop at the center.
cards.access_notes: At Suburban Square; posted center hours are Monday–Saturday 10 a.m.–8 p.m. and Sunday noon–5 p.m., with merchant hours varying.

cards.title: Apple
cards.subtitle: Lancaster Avenue corridor, Suburban Square
cards.notes: Visit the Apple storefront for a clearly named technology-retail destination in the center; confirm service or shopping needs with the store before traveling.
cards.short_summary: An Apple retail location listed in the Suburban Square shopping directory.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Suburban Square shopping directory lists Apple Computer as a current shop at the center.
cards.access_notes: At Suburban Square; posted center hours are Monday–Saturday 10 a.m.–8 p.m. and Sunday noon–5 p.m., with merchant hours varying.

cards.title: Axiom Contemporary
cards.subtitle: Lancaster Avenue corridor, Suburban Square
cards.notes: Look for the gallery’s contemporary-art presentation while exploring the shopping corridor; the center directory identifies it as featuring work by emerging artists.
cards.short_summary: A contemporary-art gallery listed at Suburban Square.
cards.evidence_claim: Suburban Square’s shopping directory lists Axiom Contemporary and describes it as contemporary art from emerging artists.
cards.access_notes: At Suburban Square; confirm gallery hours and entry details directly before a visit.
